name: myLen_replicate
prelude:
def myLen : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1
statement: theorem myLen_replicate (n : Nat) (a : α) : myLen (List.replicate n a) = n
proofs:
induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [List.replicate_succ, myLen, ih]
  have len_eq (zs : List α) : myLen zs = zs.length := by
    induction zs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons z zs ih => simp [myLen, ih]
  rw [len_eq, List.length_replicate]
strategies: Induction on arbitrary lists to characterize myLen, then use length_replicate.
